newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsicans fire at barrracks after remands.
newsitem.headline: Corsicans fire at barrracks after remands.

text.p: Suspected separatists shot at a paramilitary gendarmerie barracks in Corsica and a sentry returned fire, police said on Thursday.
Gendarmes said eight bullets hit the barracks in Saint-Florent but no-one was injured.
The shooting was one of a series of attacks on government buildings since the island's best-known separatist leader Francois Santoni was remanded in custody in Paris on Wednesday.

Santoni, head of Cuncolta Naziunalista, the legal facade of the outlawed Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC)-Historic Wing, and his lawyer girl-friend Marie-Helene Mattei were remanded and probed for attempted extortion and bomb attacks.
The government ordered a crackdown after separatists stepped up attacks in a two-decade-old campaign to demand greater autonomy from Paris for the Mediterranean holiday island.
